aboutPageTitle: Acting with humanity, building with communities.
aboutPageIntro: A national organisation committed to protection, dignity and inclusion in Niger.
whoTitle: A national presence rooted in Tahoua.
whoIntro: Humanitarian Action for Development and Protection is a national, non-political and non-profit organisation.
whoBody: HADP places people and communities at the centre of its work, combining protection, appropriate assistance and stronger local capacity.
historyDate: Founded on 7 June 2022 in Tahoua, Niger.
missionBody: To provide appropriate assistance to people in vulnerable situations, protect populations affected by crises and contribute to strengthening their livelihoods, autonomy and economic and social inclusion.
visionTitle: A future where everyone can live with dignity.
visionBody: To build a future in which every person can access essential opportunities and participate fully in the development of their community.
valuesIntro: The way we work rests on trust, respect and shared responsibility.
valueHumanityDescription: Upholding the dignity of every person.
valueEquityDescription: Recognising each person’s needs and realities.
valueResilienceDescription: Strengthening resources to respond to crises.
approachTitle: Listen, work closely and build responses that last.
approachIntro: Communities are essential actors in shaping and delivering responses.
approachBody: HADP prioritises listening, proximity, durable solutions, empowerment and stronger local capacity to support dynamics led in the field.
interventionsPageIntro: Six complementary focus areas guide HADP’s work alongside people and communities in vulnerable situations.
interventionsDetailTitle: Complementary expertise in service of communities.
interventionsDetailIntro: Each focus area contributes to a humane, structured response that is attentive to local realities.
actionsPageTitle: Practical initiatives carried out alongside communities.
actionsPageIntro: Local actions that contribute to protection, empowerment and stronger resilience.
realisedActionsIntro: These actions reflect HADP’s engagement on issues that matter to the people and communities it supports.
perspectivesBody: HADP’s directions remain guided by listening to communities, strengthening local capacity and seeking collaborations that reinforce the responses delivered.
partnersPageIntro: Collaborations grounded in trust, complementarity and a shared ambition in service of communities.
partnerTypesIntro: HADP seeks to build strong working relationships with organisations that share its commitment to dignity and inclusion.
partnerApproachTitle: Putting complementary strengths in service of communities.
partnerApproachBody: Each collaboration is designed to support responsible responses adapted to context and attentive to priorities expressed in the field.
partnerQuote: Cooperation gives greater strength to solutions built with communities.
